movelist.name: Bug Buzz
movelist.range: Cone 2 or Close Blast 2, Sonic, Smite
movelist.effect: Bug Buzz lowers the Special Defense of all targets on 19+.

movelist.name: Aromatherapy
movelist.effect: All allies in the burst are cured of one status condition of their choice.

movelist.name: Draining Kiss
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Supersonic
movelist.effect: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

movelist.name: Struggle Bug
movelist.effect: On hit, lowers the target’s Special Attack by -1 CS.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.effect: The user gains a +3 Bonus to all Accuracy Rolls.

abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.effect: The user ignores the secondary effects that trigger during Accuracy Roll of damaging Moves that target the user. For example, Flamethrower can never inflict the Burn Condition. Defensive.

abilities.name: Effect Spore
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Melee Attack
abilities.effect: Roll 1d6. On a result of 1 or 2, the attacker is Poisoned. On a result of 3 or 4, the attacker is Paralyzed. On a result of 5 or 6, the attacker falls Asleep.
